sources.inspected_scope: Cover, title page, imprint, and original scanned printed pages 100-104; printed page 71 also inspected during navigation. Relevant argument is in printed pp. 100-102, paragraphs 91-93.

exact_locator.paragraph_91: Printed p. 100 continuing onto p. 101: metaphor alone insufficient; attribution to the head; comparison with constructions making grayness the subject.
exact_locator.paragraph_92: Printed p. 101: comprehensiveness or spread; contrast with fire in a house versus a house ablaze.
exact_locator.paragraph_93: Printed p. 102: comparison with Quran 54:12 and additional observation about the definite article in al-ra's.

supports: Exact original attribution of the literary analysis to al-Jurjani
Role of grammatical arrangement in addition to metaphor
The author's interpretation of comprehensive grayness
The two analytical Arabic alternative constructions used in the chapter
Observation about the understood possessor of the definite expression the head
sources.verification_method: Downloaded original scan, rendered with PyMuPDF, visually inspected title/imprint and passage images. Printed page numbers read directly. Web fetch of the Internet Archive redirect failed, but direct curl retrieval succeeded. No scan images reproduced in the manuscript.
limitations: This verifies the cited edition and passage, not the entire book or the manuscript history of its text.
The Usul route number 100 displays printed p. 89; route numbers must not be substituted for printed page numbers.
A separate generated Shamela search result reported 1412 AH, whereas the inspected scan imprint reads 1413 AH; the manuscript follows the inspected imprint.
The classical analysis is an argument and evaluation, not modern experimental evidence.
A durable local archival copy was not added to the project; temporary verification files may be removed by the operating system.

supports: Reading the physical descriptions as preparation for the request and appeal for mercy
Interpretation of the fire image through luminous spread across a dark surface
Context-sensitive reading of the verse rather than detached rhetorical-device counting
limitations: No physical edition or page image inspected; no edition-specific page claim made.
Biological statements, historical reports, and inheritance interpretations appearing in the commentary have not been independently verified and are not adopted as established facts.
The author's account is exegetical and literary interpretation, not a reader-response study.
